description: This file is a PHP template responsible for rendering and handling the form for editing glossary entries in an admin panel. It includes form fields for title, text, image gallery, media, and legend, as well as JavaScript to initialize a rich text editor (CKEditor). It also references external JavaScript and uses PHP classes for form handling and model validation.

classes.name: Model\Glossary
classes.description: Model class representing glossary data, used here for validation and data retrieval.

methods.description: Initializes a form with specific configuration, generates HTML form elements based on provided array.
